thesis: Resurrecting Atlantis: he walks with the ancestors through the light gates into the city that rises.
character: HIM: a Black man in his thirties with close-cropped hair and a short beard, wearing a matte black mock-neck long sleeve, black trousers and black boots. THE ANCESTORS: Black women and men of every age walking with him, in long robes of deep indigo, ochre, blue, gold and white.

shots.action: Dusk. He walks along a long straight road toward two tall white gates; the gates swing open like wings.
He walks up a yellow road through the open gates; the ancestors walk beside him on both sides.
Tall blocks rise out of the ground on both sides of the road as he and the ancestors walk into the city.
He walks through a wide plaza among the ancestors; shallow water flows across the ground around their feet.
Night. A candle burns in every window; he walks slowly while people stand in the doorways smiling.
He walks down a narrow street between tall blocks, strings of light overhead and people on both sides.
Bands of rainbow light arc over the city and the clouds lift away; he stops and looks up.
He stands in the middle of the plaza, the whole city lit around him, the ancestors gathered round him.

third_person: THIRD PERSON, like an open-world video game. The camera floats two metres behind him and a little above his shoulders. He is centred in the lower half of the frame, his whole body visible from behind, about one third of the frame's height. The camera follows him and never passes him or looks away from him.

styles.greyfig: STYLE: a grey-box video game world. Flat untextured blocks, small lit yellow squares for windows, flat ground, simple block figures. Keep this exact flat blocky look; add no texture or realism. The man walking away from us in the lower middle of the starting picture is him: keep him exactly there, seen from behind.
